newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek core inflation rises to 8.2 pct yr/yr in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Greek core inflation rises to 8.2 pct yr/yr in Dec.

text.p: Greece's core CPI-based inflation, which does not include volatile food and energy prices, rose to 8.2 percent year-on-year in December from 8.0 percent in November, an economist at a foreign bank told Reuters.

Headline CPI inflation fell to 7.5 percent year-on-year in December from 7.7 percent in November, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement earlier today. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
